evidence.text: opv exposes about twenty CLI commands and eleven MCP tools, each with its own input and output shape.
The owner wants every capability available through both CLI and MCP, so the surface keeps growing.
Different assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) use a large, irregular tool surface inconsistently, in different orders.

desiredImprovement: Completeness of capabilities exposed to assistants
worseningOutcome: Consistency and learnability of the surface for assistants
